title: Tackling fraud as an ecosystem: Exploring the shift needed in regulation and the industry
summary: What ecosystem and regulatory changes are needed to create true industry-wide collaboration to fight fraud?
content: Fighting modern financial fraud requires a fundamental shift towards industry-wide collaboration. Experts are exploring how the current regulatory landscape and business practices must evolve to treat fraud as an interconnected ecosystem issue. Achieving true security across sectors demands aligned strategies and shared intelligence among all participants, moving beyond isolated defensive measures.

The post Extortion Group Threatens To Release Florida Driver’s License Details, Photographs, Signatures and Addresses appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: An extortion group known as ShinyHunters has listed the State of Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles on its data leak site. A purported system screenshot was published as evidence, though the alleged breach remains unconfirmed by the agency.

title: MEXC launches Opportunity Compass as 53.7% of crypto users move into stocks, but knowledge gaps remain

content: MEXC has officially launched Opportunity Compass, a global markets education initiative designed to help crypto-native users navigate traditional finance. The multi-season program partners with industry experts to bridge this education divide and improve understanding of emerging financial opportunities.
